Mar 17, 2026 · 7 articles 17 Mar, 2026

AI can help usher in a new era of discovery and make quality healthcare a global reality. By improving disease detection and expanding access to care, we’re bridging the gap for communities everywhere.

Today at The Check Up, our annual health event, we shared the updates and partnerships making that future possible.

Dr. Michael Howell

Chief Health Officer, Google
